newsitem.title: USA: Bolivia sells reconstituted crude for late Feb.
newsitem.headline: Bolivia sells reconstituted crude for late Feb.

text.p: Bolivia's state-owned oil company sold 250,000 barrels of reconstituted crude to a U.S. domestic refiner for loading Feb 24-25, trade sources said Friday.
Yacimientos Petroliferos Fiscales Bolivianos (YPFB) sold the crude at a discount of around $4.79 a barrel to benchmark West Texas Intermediate/Cushing.
Bolivia's reconstituted crude contains about 45 percent gasoline, raising its API gravity to about 45 degrees.
The crude loads at the Chilean port of Arica.
The Andean country holds tenders for reconstituted crude about every two months.
